acceptance_criteria.description: Bundle construction fails closed for a symlinked source root or linked ancestor and copies only allowlisted canonical regular files.

A tarball-installed consumer runs real init on a copied Tauri fixture and proves the staged 46-file attributable provider and project-relative Cargo selection include the modified dialog route/permission.
Package, release-safety, build, pack, and full provider-focused checks pass.

closed_decisions: The build copier must reject a symlinked/non-canonical provider source root and any allowlisted source whose real path differs from its expected path because of a linked ancestor; final entries must remain regular non-link files within the canonical root.

The installed-tarball contract must copy a Tauri fixture, execute the installed pumarejo init command against it, and verify the relative Cargo dependency, canonical provider manifest entries, and representative modified provider route/permission files from the installed package.
The tarball proof may copy only the neutral Tauri fixture from the repository; provider content must come exclusively through the packed and installed package, never repository vendor or dist paths.
Keep shell=false, bounded temporary cleanup, and existing package import/bin assertions.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit provider source, installer production code, public MCP/dialog behavior, process custody, dependencies/lockfiles, docs, queue/blocker/release files, git, Jira, or pull requests.
Do not weaken the curated allowlist, rely on repository provider content after tarball installation, enable shell execution, or write absolute paths into target project files/evidence.
objective: Close the two provider reviewer findings by proving the packed consumer can run init from packaged source and by preventing symlinked source roots or ancestor traversal during bundle construction.
